title: Crashout Schoolgirl and Degen Teacher
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a painful romantic rejection, high school student Mikoto Ochiai decides to end her life, but her young physics teacher, Jin Haiba, stops her at the last moment and proposes that she date him before she dies. He keeps turning up whenever she struggles, distracting her from despair, and over time she genuinely falls for him but hides it because he is her teacher. The tone mixes black comedy with a student-teacher romance (Wikipedia; Comikey blurb; MU Black Humor).
life_message: Someone choosing to stay beside you can be a reason to keep living.

content.note: Opens at a suicide attempt; grief over dead family members (MU Death of Loved One/s, Dead Family Member/s).
